newsitem.title: UK: DFS rebounds from nine-month lows.
newsitem.headline: DFS rebounds from nine-month lows.

text.p: Shares in DFS Furniture Plc rose sharply on Friday, rebounding from the nine-month low set earlier this week ahead of first-half results next week, dealers said.
Dealers pointed out that the furniture superstore operator remained a volatile and illiquid stock which did not require much news for it to move quite sharply.
"It is very tightly held and difficult to trade," said one. DFS shares were up 18p at 520-1/2 by 1344 GMT in volume of 323,676 shares.
The stock touched a low of 500p on Wednesday, its lowest since last July and some 23.5 percent below its record 654 set in January.
In the year to July 1996, DFS pre-tax profit rose to 31.1 million stg from 26.2 million stg a year before.
DFS suffered a setback in early March as rival MFI Furniture Group Plc posted a surprise slowdown in second-half sales growth, warning that its market had not yet seen a sustained uplift in demand.
